title: Explain Unix daemon stream isolation at PreventParentStreamInheritance
outcome: Future maintainers can see that redirected stdout/stderr replace Unix descriptors 1 and 2, while Windows still requires SetHandleInformation.
acceptance: The method comment or early-return comment states why Unix needs no explicit inheritance mutation and accurately scopes the Windows-only handle operation.

completion.summary: Daemon stream-isolation documentation now scopes the explicit inheritance mutation to Windows and explains why redirected Unix descriptors need no separate mutation.
